title: JANUS Gift: Undina's Comb for Roses — Strict TimeShift V0.2.1
canonical_principles: JANUS must not chase the wave. It must know its speed and meet it ahead.
Do not stop the water; draw the comb through it so one controlled crest gives birth to the next.
Old batches after resume are foam, not a new crest.

strict_wave_pump_formula.candidate: new admissions after resume + completion cluster from those admissions + absence in matched sham

components.CREST_ESTIMATOR: Estimates crest position and speed without reading digest quality.
components.FOAM_METER: Separates old in-flight completions, lead debt, actuation advance and final boundary foam.
components.STRICT_SHIFT_WINDOW: Commits only inside the latest-safe window; waits before it and aborts after it.
components.TIMESHIFT_ENGINE: Computes anticipatory lead from observed completion dynamics and actuation latency.
components.LEAD_BARRIER: Places the intervention ahead of the predicted crest.
components.TOO_LATE_ABORT: Declines an action after the safe window has passed.
components.COMB_CONTROLLER: Schedules bounded real and sham multi-pulse policies.
components.HOLD_QUIESCENCE_PROOF: Requires no exposure, finalized or submitted advance during a real hold.
components.ADMISSION_EPOCH: Uses dispatch timestamps after resume to identify new admissions.
components.STRICT_LOCAL_CREST: Counts a crest only from completions belonging to post-resume admissions.

package_incident.error: PACKAGE_FILE_MISSING with an empty file name during PowerShell preflight.
package_incident.root_cause: PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json files[] entries were strings while the launcher expected objects containing path and sha256.
package_incident.hotfix: Restore 18 manifest entries as path/sha256/size_bytes/role objects.

live_gate.current_action: Run PREFLIGHT_ONLY.cmd then START_CALIBRATION_1_MATRIX.cmd from V0.2.1.

claim_limits: V0.2.1 has passed offline validation only.
External whole-process hold remains a proxy and may yield zero new admissions after resume.
A negative strict candidate is useful evidence for implementing a native admission gate.
No Wave Pump, energy saving, or persistent memory is claimed before live matched-sham evidence.
